options.description: Push with --no-verify. Nothing depends on main downstream: GitHub is empty and nobody else pulls it. The clean full run and your questions still happen, on their own schedule, before the next push.
options.label: Skip the check once (Recommended)

options.description: I run the clean full run, you answer the 11 questions as the agent asks them, and I record SR-265#15 by hand. Nothing reaches GitHub until all three are done, and the approved branches wait too.
options.label: Clear every hold first

payload.question: Pushing main to Cols77/plumb is held by things the push itself can't clear: 11 questions of yours about the pane, the band cards and the question pacing, a clean full test run (about 20 minutes, still owed), and SR-265#15, which the repin tool refuses because the renamed test's old version is gone from git. How should I push?
